units.source_text: 夹馅面包与我的关系，究竟是什么关系呢？

en.t: What exactly was the relationship between the filled bread and me?

units.source_text: 我这样预想：面对着行动，

en.t: I imagined it this way: when faced with action,

units.source_text: 精神无论多么振奋于紧张和集中，

en.t: no matter how much the spirit might be stirred by tension and concentration,

units.source_text: 我那依然孤独地残留的胃即使在这种时候，恐怕还是寻求那孤独的保证吧。

en.t: even at such a time, my stomach, still left behind in solitude, was probably seeking confirmation of that solitude.

units.source_text: 我感到我的内脏好像我那寒怆而又决不驯服的家犬。

en.t: I felt that my entrails were like my bleak and never-tame house dog.

units.source_text: 我知道，我的精神无论多么觉醒，

en.t: I knew that no matter how awake my spirit might be,

units.source_text: 我的胃和局这些感觉迟钝的内脏器官梦见的还是厨房里的温乎乎的日常生活。

en.t: what my stomach and these dull-sensed organs still dreamed of was the warm everyday life of the kitchen.
